name: grain-market-pos
description: Offline desktop POS for grain market — Electron + React + Express + SQLite
author: Sheraz Traders

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run electron:dev"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:electron && wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 http://127.0.0.1:3847/api/health && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.electron:build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist:win: npm run electron:build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win
